assertions.assertion: The appeal is for a CO-97 denial
CPT 93271 is a cardiac event monitoring study
The study was ordered for this patient
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The clinical indication raises concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The diagnosis code I48.0 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation) is assigned
The diagnosis code Z86.73 (personal history of transient ischemic attacks) is assigned
The diagnosis code G45.9 (cerebral infarction) is assigned
The study was performed to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events
The study was performed to guide anticoagulation management
CPT 93271 is separately billable rather than denied under CO-97
